card.name: Verbs after Do not / Never
card.fires_on: The word right after a prohibition such as "Do not give X" or "Never", mainly "more" (before "frequently than" or "than 1 time") and "share" (a pen). It also fires on "attempt" and "flames" in warnings.

modes.label: "more" after a drug name
modes.description: "more" follows "Do not give/use [product]" and leads into a limit on how often.
modes.example: Do not give Lomustine Capsules<< more>> frequently than every 6 weeks

modes.label: "share" after Never
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Never<< share>> a Insulin Aspart FlexPen,

modes.label: Other warned actions
modes.description: A verb or noun completing a don't-do-this instruction.
modes.example: • Do not<< attempt>> to reuse ZEGALOGUE.

card.plain: It lights up on the key word of a "do not" warning, like "more" in "do not use more often than" or "share" a pen.
